methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try per Pokémon, alphas too; 4 with the Shiny Charm. A Pokémon's shininess is set when it appears, so leaving and coming back re-rolls it.
methods.note: PKHeX Templates/Gen9a EncounterSlot9a.cs ShinyCharm = 3; Kaphotics: '+3 shiny rolls instead of +2'; respawn re-roll is community practice [single]

methods.name: Hyperspace with Sparkling Power
methods.plain: In Hyperspace (Mega Dimension), eat a Sparkling Power donut: Pokémon of its type get better shiny odds, and at level 3 the first one of that type that appears near you is shiny.
methods.detail: Level 1/2/3: +1/+2/+3 tries, only in Hyperspace; the Shiny Charm stacks (level 3 + charm = 7 tries). The forced shiny is the first matching Pokémon on entering a Hyperspace wild zone.
methods.note: PKHeX EncounterSlot9a.cs ShinyHyperspace = 3 (it models only the rolls); the forced spawn from Anubis / RotomLabs [multiple]

methods.name: Fossil revivals
methods.plain: Revived fossils (Aerodactyl, Tyrunt, Amaura) are 1 in 4,096; the Shiny Charm doesn't help.
methods.note: PKHeX Encounters9a.cs fossils Shiny = Random; EncounterStatic9a ignores the charm for them
